# Test fixtures

- `face.jpg` — resized official portrait of Barack Obama (White House, public domain,
  https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Barack_Obama.jpg). Used to verify face
  detection, embedding generation and matching.
- `face2.jpg` — resized official presidential portrait of Joe Biden (White House, public domain,
  https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Joe_Biden_presidential_portrait.jpg). Used as a
  different identity in matching tests.
